name: Question 5
problem:
The value $P(t)$ of a painting is given by the function

$$
P(t)=250+{\int }_{0}^{t}({3}^{x/4}-27)\,\text{d}x,
$$

where $P$ is measured in dollars, and $t>0$ is the time (in years) since the painting was created. 

At what time is the value a minimum, and how much does the painting cost at this time, rounded to the nearest dollar?

The minimum value is
$$$

worked_solution:
To find when the value is minimized, we need to solve $\frac{\text{d}P}{\text{d}t}=0.$ First, we differentiate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}P}{\text{d}t} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(250+{\int }_{0}^{t}({3}^{x/4}-27)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(250)+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({\int }_{0}^{t}({3}^{x/4}-27)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}{\int }_{0}^{t}({3}^{x/4}-27)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={3}^{t/4}-27\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve $\frac{\text{d}P}{\text{d}t}=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{3}^{t/4}-27 & =0 \\ {3}^{t/4} & ={3}^{3} \\ \frac{t}{4} & =3 \\ t & =12\end{aligned}
$$

So there are two candidates for global extrema, $t=0$ and $t=12.$ To find out the value of the painting when $t=12,$ we figure out $P(12):$

$$
\begin{aligned}P(12) & =250+{\int }_{0}^{12}({3}^{x/4}-27)\,\text{d}x \\  & =250+{[\frac{4\cdot {3}^{x/4}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}-27x]|}_{0}^{12} \\  & =250+[(\frac{4\cdot 27}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}-324)-(\frac{4\cdot 1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3})] \\  & =250-324+\frac{108-4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3} \\  & =-74+\frac{104}{\operatorname{ln}⁡3} \\  & ≈21,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.

Since $21<250,$ we conclude that the minimum value is $$\,21$, and this happens after $12$ years.

EXPLANATION

To find when the value is minimized, we need to solve dPdt=0. First, we differentiate:

dPdt=ddt(250+∫0t(3x/4−27)dx)=ddt(250)+ddt(∫0t(3x/4−27)dx)=ddt∫0t(3x/4−27)dx=3t/4−27

Now, we solve dPdt=0:

3t/4−27=03t/4=33t4=3t=12

So there are two candidates for global extrema, t=0 and t=12. To find out the value of the painting when t=12, we figure out P(12):

P(12)=250+∫012(3x/4−27)dx=250+[4⋅3x/4ln⁡3−27x]|012=250+[(4⋅27ln⁡3−324)−(4⋅1ln⁡3)]=250−324+108−4ln⁡3=−74+104ln⁡3≈21, rounded to the nearest integer.

Since 21<250, we conclude that the minimum value is $21, and this happens after 12 years.
